A '''battle''' was fought in the [[Tartaglia system/Legends|Tartaglia system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] [[Orinda campaign]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. After the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] new [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], captured six [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] along the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] as a show of force against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the New Republic dispatched the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' to counter the Imperials. While ''Lusankya'' was en route, the Imperial [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]], under the leadership of [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], captured both Tartaglia [[Battle of Hewett|and]] [[Hewett]] from the New Republic with the assistance of a complement of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].
